name: mc1_sl
description: Multicore stage 1 (doc/perf/multicore-baseline-2026-11.md) on Second Life. The owner logs in by hand at home; the plugin records the login region, shows a local pop-up (Ready for the busy region: teleport there now), waits for the owner's teleport, settles, then runs three 60 s Tracy captures (MC1-still: the current camera; MC1-moving and MC1-moving-2: the camera turns at 10 deg/s), five teleports within the busy region and five between it and the login region (one continuous capture, MC1-teleports), then the frame rate for 60 s with no capture connected, and a final pop-up. Run with --no-glstats (the measuring build has no GLSubmitStats): frame rates come from the FrameCounters log lines.

owner_teleport.ready_message: Ready for the busy region: teleport there now.
